سِحَآءٌ : see سِحَآءَةٌ, in two places. ＝
-A2- Also A certain plant, (S, K,) having thorns, (K,) and having a blossom of a red hue inclining to whiteness, called the بهرنة [app. a mistranscription for بَهْرَمَة]: (TA:) the bees feed upon it, (S, K,) and their honey in consequence thereof becomes sweet (S, K *) in the utmost degree. (K.) ＝
-A3- See also سَحَاةٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
